result:
Round 153 (label typography) **passes** in real Chromium at 1440×900 and 1280×720, with no bugs found. `browserVerified` and `realVerified` are both true. One check is blocked: the fake-Bearer 403, because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

- **Code and scope:** the 7 targeted test files pass 89/89, the same as A, and TH9 checks the six labels. HEAD is `ff2fd6c` and the 962 frozen files are unchanged. A changed exactly 9 files plus the new doc 124. The protected files have no diff, and `app.css` gains only the 3 token lines. No source changed while I was testing.
- **Label style:** all six labels (Master, Zoom, Arrangement, BPM, Markers, Loop) render at 11px, 500 weight, 1.54px letter-spacing and uppercase, in Instrument Sans loaded from the web. The text in the page is still the original case. Control names for screen readers are unchanged.
- **Layout:** nothing moves vertically, no panel moves, no element appears or disappears, and two runs give identical positions. Only 6 controls shift sideways: Follow −10, BPM input and Metronome +1.5, the marker buttons +19. Label widths match B's simulation exactly; the largest shift is 26 px, from "Arrangement" pushing "· Overview" and the video caption.
- **One correction to B's prediction:** the task expected the Master mute, volume and peak controls to move about −14 px. They don't move; only the Master group and its label grow to the left. B's own simulation says the same, so the task text was wrong, not the app.
- **Clipping:** nothing new is cut off, wrapped or overflowing, including the 224 px BPM and Markers header columns and the video caption with `beeps-6s-h264-aac.mp4` loaded.
- **Store pages:** the home and cart pages load none of the Studio fonts and have no element with the new letter-spacing; hovering or focusing the "Studio Lab" link prefetches one font stylesheet, which the task allows. `/studio-lab` requests the same font set as round 152, with no Cormorant.
- **Function smoke:**
  - Play, a clip drag with Ctrl+Z, BPM 90, the Zoom slider, adding markers and jumping between them, Ctrl+L and the Export dialog all work.
  - A real WAV export lasts 150.3724 s, has no invalid samples, and is byte-identical to round 152's export.
  - After Ctrl+L turns the loop off, the range is kept and the LOOP label does not come back. After Ctrl+Z removes the loop, LOOP returns with the new style. This is unchanged app behaviour, recorded as a note.
- **Sign-in protection:** `/studio-lab` opens anonymously as the demo, and `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace and no audio. `/api/studio-token` returns 401.

My first run at 1440 hit the known cold-start error on the dev server's first page load; I replaced it once and kept the log.

Notes for B:
- I said "uppercase" rendering wasn't tested with a real screen reader.
- The task points to doc 123 line 67, but the edited sentence is on line 70, as A disclosed.
- In the round-152 layout tool, the tempo-row entry doesn't match anything on the page, so I measured that row directly; it doesn't move.

The full suite, typecheck, build, Biome, verify and e2e smoke are left to the gate. RV-2 contrast and FONT-FAIL weren't required this round; the contrast check ran anyway with 32 failures, the same as round 152.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop:
- c-round-153.md
- c-round-153.json
- c-round-153/
